verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a public REST interface for connecting to and calling tools on MCP servers. It is backed by API keys, scoped service tokens for agents, and namespace-scoped key management, and supplemented by generated typed SDKs and a CLI for searching, adding and calling tools. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the standard paths. That makes the API less machine-discoverable, but it does not contradict that the API exists. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec or endpoint-level reference, evidence that management actions (publishing, namespace administration) are API-drivable, and independent hands-on corroboration of the API.
